verdict.rationale: DBOS documents durable streaming that lets agents stream output as it is generated. Writes are persisted, so after a mid-response restart the reader keeps receiving values without dropping output. This directly covers streaming live tokens or progress from a running workflow. Missing for 10: concrete API details for writing and reading streams, documented delivery into a browser frontend (e.g., SSE/WebSocket wiring), explicit step-progress examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
